screens:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create a single premium UI design presentation showing THREE complete iPhone screens side-by-side, labeled TODAY, PLAN, PROGRESS. Brand Protein Pilot. Art direction FIELD NOTES: warm ivory #F5F1E8, deep forest #244735, near-black ink, quiet warm brass details, editorial serif headings paired with exceptionally legible humanist sans-serif numerals and body. Fine hairline dividers, generous consistent spacing, subtle paper texture, botanical illustration used very sparingly. Main screens crisp and flat like real native app screenshots, not a dashboard template. No scenic background photography. No generic giant rounded card stacks. Badges are beautifully tactile brass and dark green enamel botanical pins. Label at top of board "PROTEIN PILOT / FIELD NOTES" and small "Design concept".
TODAY phone: small brand header "protein pilot", heading "A day well nourished.", date "Thursday, October 29"; hero large "152" and smaller "/ 152 g", small status "Your target, reached". Quiet three-section progress line complete. Below header "Your journal", three sophisticated horizontal meal rows with small tasteful circular food photos: "Yogurt, oats & berries" breakfast "48.3 g"; "Lentil & rice bowl" lunch "40.5 g"; "Chickpea & lentil bowl" dinner "63.2 g". Modest outlined button "Log a meal". Small subtle earned seedling pin note "A little consistency grows." Native bottom tabs Today, Plan, Log, Progress with Today selected.
PLAN phone: heading "Your week, considered.", subheading "Vegetarian · excludes soy"; seven-day selector Thu 29 selected, Fri 30 Sat 31 Sun 1 Mon 2 Tue 3 Wed 4. Compact summary "152 g planned / 152 g target". Tiny text "Planned meals count after you log them." Three refined meal sections labeled BREAKFAST, LUNCH, DINNER with same recipe names and proteins as Today, thumb food images, clear "Swap" text action each, portion captions "331 g yogurt + oats & berries", "331 g lentils + rice & broccoli", "331 g chickpeas + lentils & broccoli". Quiet footer link "Ingredients & planning notes". Native bottom tabs with Plan selected.
PROGRESS phone: heading "Your rhythm.", hero "2 days logged" and small "1 day at target"; seven calendar positions Fri Sat Sun Mon Tue Wed Thu: first five empty outlined markers, last two filled forest markers. Caption "Blank days mean no entries." Below "Your collection" tasteful horizontal badge shelf: earned Seedling enamel pin, muted locked Seven Days calendar pin with "2 / 7 days", muted locked Rhythm seven-dot pin with "2 / 5 days". A small row "View all 12 badges". Native bottom tabs with Progress selected.
All three screens from the same exact product system. Mature, quietly joyful, beautifully composed. Text must be accurate; numeric examples consistent. No calorie minimization, no protein quality scores, no confetti, no trophy emoji, no arbitrary gradients, no motivational claims beyond specified copy. Whole screens fully visible. Large landscape image, readable UI.
badges:
Use case: stylized-concept. Design a complete collectible achievement badge sheet for Protein Pilot, art direction FIELD NOTES. Exactly 12 distinct badges in a precise 4 columns by 3 rows grid. Title "FIELD NOTES" with subtitle "The Protein Pilot collection". Premium physical enamel pin renderings, deep forest green and ivory vitreous enamel, restrained brushed warm brass rims, subtle engraved details, realistic small shadows on warm ivory paper. Botanical field-journal identity, mature and beautifully crafted, no cartoon trophy icons, no plastic toy look, no rainbow tiers, no purple gradients. Every badge must have a distinct recognizable silhouette, work at small size, and feel part of one collection. Large clear serif name below each, small uppercase category below name. NO earning criteria or nutrition numbers except specified icon numerals. Exact row-major sequence:
1 "Seedling" category "FIRST LOG": asymmetrical two-leaf sprout with brass stem.
2 "Seven Days" category "LOGGING": square rounded brass calendar with forest enamel face and engraved numeral 7.
3 "Rhythm" category "CONSISTENCY": circular medallion with seven small seed dots around rim, five dark-green filled dots and two ivory dots.
4 "Rooted" category "CONSISTENCY": arched pin with a tree above ground and branching roots below.
5 "Homecoming" category "RETURNING": curled brass return arrow encircling a small leaf.
6 "Mise en Place" category "PLANNING": rectangular botanical field notebook open with three small recipe tabs and a leaf bookmark.
7 "Follow Through" category "PLAN TO PLATE": elegant round dinner plate with a small leaf and a brass check mark.
8 "Explorer" category "VARIETY": eight-point compass medallion with botanical north arrow.
9 "Plant Sampler" category "PLANT VARIETY": scalloped green medallion with three distinct seed-pod motifs.
10 "Portion Check" category "REVIEW": small balanced kitchen scale with a leaf in its bowl, fine brass outlines.
11 "Protein Wise" category "LEARNING": open-book pin with a fine sprout on one page and a small magnifying lens.
12 "Personal Rhythm" category "YOUR RANGE": oval pin with two curved brass brackets surrounding one forest green central dot; no bullseye, no upward arrow.
Ensure all twelve names exact, no duplicate badges, generous negative space, sophisticated product-photography lighting, consistent size. These are concept assets, shown earned; production locked states will use outline versions. Landscape image.
